# Preview Project

This workflow explains how to start the development server to preview the Next.js project locally.

## Prerequisites
- Dependencies installed (`npm install`)

## Steps

1. **Start the Development Server**
   Run the following command to start the Next.js local development server:
   ```bash
   npm run dev
   ```

2. **Access the Preview**
   Once the server starts, open your browser and navigate to:
   [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000)

   The app will automatically reload if you make edits to any source files.
